arxiv-2011-11423.title: Superheavy dark matter in R 2 R^{2} -cosmology
arxiv-2011-11423.creator: E. V. Arbuzova
arxiv-2011-11423.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by E. V. Arbuzova. The conventional Friedmann cosmology is known to be in tension with the existence of stable particles having interaction strength typical for supersymmetry and heavier than several TeV. A possible way to save life of such particles may be a modification of the standard cosmological expansion law in such a way that the density of these heavy relics would be significantly reduced. We study particle creation in the Starobinsky inflationary model for different decay channels of the scalaron.

arxiv-2107-06034.title: Search strategy for gluinos at the LHC
arxiv-2107-06034.creator: with a Higgs boson decaying into tau leptons
arxiv-2107-06034.description: Abstract The possibility in supersymmetric scenarios that the dark matter candidate is a Higgsino-like neutralino means that its production can be associated with Higgs bosons. Taking advantage of this fact, we propose a LHC search strategy for gluinos with τ \tau leptons in the final state, coming from the decay of a Higgs boson.

arxiv-2212-02192.description: Abstract Behavioral studies using personal digital devices typically produce rich longitudinal datasets of mixed data types. These data provide information about the behavior of users of these devices in real-time and in the users’ natural environments. Analyzing the data requires multidisciplinary expertise and dedicated software.

arxiv-2304-01504.title: One stabilization is not enough for closed knotted surfaces
arxiv-2304-01504.creator: Kyle Hayden, Sungkyung Kang, Anubhav Mukherjee
arxiv-2304-01504.description: Abstract . In this brief note, we show that there exist smooth 4-manifolds (with nonempty boundary) containing pairs of exotically knotted 2-spheres that remain exotic after one (either external or internal) stabilization. It follows that the “one is enough” theorem of Auckly-Kim-Melvin-Ruberman-Schwartz does not hold for closed surfaces whose homology classes are characteristic. Kyle Hayden, Sungkyung Kang, Anubhav Mukherjee 1.

arxiv-2304-09809.creator: Giacomo Ceoldo, Ernst C. Wit
arxiv-2304-09809.description: Abstract The package hset for the R language contains an implementation of a S4 class for sets and multisets of numbers. The implementation, based on the hash table data structure from the package hash ( Brown 2019 ) , allows for quick operations when the set is a dynamic object.

arxiv-2406-01228.title: LSKSANet: A Novel Architecture for Remote Sensing Image Semantic Segmentation Leveraging Large Selective Kernel and Sparse Attention Mechanism Thanks: This work was supported in part by the National Key Research and Development Program of China under Grant 2022ZD0117202 and in part by the Natural Sc
arxiv-2406-01228.creator: Miao Fu, Feng Gao, Ruzhuang Hua, Yanhai Gan, Xiaowei Zhou, Yang Zhou
arxiv-2406-01228.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Miao Fu, Feng Gao, Ruzhuang Hua, Yanhai Gan, Xiaowei Zhou, Yang Zhou. In this paper, we proposed large selective kernel and sparse attention network (LSKSANet) for remote sensing image semantic segmentation. The LSKSANet is a lightweight network that effectively combines convolution with sparse attention mechanisms. Specifically, we design large selective kernel module to decomposing the large kernel into a series of depth-wise convolutions with progressively increasing dilation rates, thereby expanding the receptive field without significantly increasing the computational burden.

arxiv-2411-18334.title: Large multi-response linear regression estimation based on low-rank pre-smoothing
arxiv-2411-18334.creator: Xinle Tian, Alex Gibberd, Matthew A. Nunes, Sandipan Roy
arxiv-2411-18334.description: Abstract Pre-smoothing is a technique aimed at increasing the signal-to-noise ratio in data to improve subsequent estimation and model selection in regression problems. However, pre-smoothing has thus far been limited to the univariate response regression setting. However, there are many scientific applications in which interest lies in multi-response regression problems, particularly when the number of responses is large.

arxiv-2507-08876.title: Network reciprocity turns cheap talk into a force for cooperation
arxiv-2507-08876.creator: Zhao Song, Chen Shen, The Anh Han
arxiv-2507-08876.description: Abstract Non-binding communication is common in daily life and crucial for fostering cooperation, even though it has no direct payoff consequences. However, despite robust empirical evidence, its evolutionary basis remains poorly understood. Here, we develop a game-theoretic model in which individuals can signal an intention to cooperate before playing a Donation game.

arxiv-2602-22724.description: Abstract . Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools and retrieval systems to autonomously complete complex tasks. pmc-12827435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study conducted the cost-utility analysis (CUA) and budget impact analysis (BIA) of desmopressin acetate compared with imipramine and no treatment in children aged ≥ 7 years with MNE who have not responded to behavioural management and not responded, or expected not to respond, to alarm therapy.

To both elucidate these mechanisms and identify vulnerabilities caused by these mutations, we leverage genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screening in hundreds of cancer cell lines and identify the chromatin reader protein PHIP as a specific dependency in cancers with broadly disrupted SWI/SNF function.

pmc-13560414.description: PurposePhysical Activity on Prescription (PAP) is increasingly implemented within Swedish school health services, yet little is known about how it is experienced in educational settings. pmc-13684570.title: GLORB: Robust Bayesian inference for differential expression under global expression shifts
pmc-13684570.creator: Rowan Callahan, Stephen D. Coleman, Thuy T. M. Ngo
pmc-13684570.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Estimating differential gene expression is a common task in RNA-seq. Current methods mostly rely on normalization to reduce variance and increase accuracy. These methods are widely used and provide invaluable information about transcriptomic changes between biological conditions. However, widely used normalization methods are known to distort estimates of transcript differential expression when a majority of genes are upregulated or downregulated, or when the total RNA content per cell changes.
